title: The Clean Two-Query Threshold for Unitary Synthesis
description:
We establish matching fixed-error resource thresholds for clean two-query unitary synthesis. For a fixed two-query architecture with arbitrary contractions and independent unimodular phase selectors, the Gaussian mean width is at most 2 min(N,Q) sqrt(log(2Q)). Universal clean synthesis of n-qubit unitaries therefore requires Omega(2^n) qubits and, by address compression, Omega(2^n) Boolean oracle input bits independently of workspace. A permutation-transport construction attains O(2^n log(1/epsilon)) qubits and address bits using two Boolean queries to one table.

The paper includes complete proof appendices and a sufficient conjugation transfer for the garbage model. It does not resolve unrestricted two-query synthesis with garbage or the full Aaronson-Kuperberg problem. Finite verification scripts and scoped Lean 4 checks accompany the paper; the complete analytic proof is not formalized. The fresh-context AI audit is not external peer review.
